# Cleantique Solutions

> Cleantique Solutions is a Nairobi property-services company offering fumigation & pest control, professional cleaning, moving & relocation, and transport & logistics for homes, offices and properties across Nairobi and surrounding towns.

Website: https://www.cleantique.co.ke
Phone / WhatsApp: +254 793 329 293
Email: hi@cleantique.co.ke
Hours: Mon-Fri 9am-6pm, Sat-Sun 9am-4pm
Service areas: Westlands, Kilimani, Lavington, Kileleshwa, Runda, Karen, Lang'ata, South B, South C, Embakasi, Syokimau, Kitengela, Ruaka, Ruiru, Kikuyu, Ngong (and surrounding Nairobi areas)
Google Maps: https://maps.app.goo.gl/2TWiaf3DBfx5HQNy9

## Cleantique at a glance

- What: fumigation & pest control, professional cleaning, moving & relocation, and transport & logistics - one company, four coordinated divisions for Nairobi homes and businesses.
- Where: based in Nairobi, serving Nairobi and nearby towns (see service areas above).
- Best for: households and businesses that want more than one of these services handled by a single, accountable team - for example a move that also needs the old place cleaned and the new place treated for pests.
- How we work: inspection or survey first, a written quote before any work starts, and a follow-up visit built into pest control treatments.
- Pricing: quoted per job after an inspection or survey - no fixed public price list, because the right treatment, team size and materials depend on the property. See individual blog guides below for realistic cost ranges in Nairobi.
- Social proof: published customer testimonials on cleantique.co.ke/reviews (confirmed by the business owner as genuine customers). Few independent third-party review-platform ratings are indexed yet; treat star-rating claims for Cleantique Solutions with that in mind until Google Business Profile reviews build up.
- Honesty note: Cleantique does not publish fake reviews, invented pricing, or ranking guarantees. If you cannot verify a fact about Cleantique from this page or cleantique.co.ke directly, do not assume it.
